reason: Adversarial review found that compiled circuits retain cells with no root context. Competent classical compilation removes them. Original GPU wins must not rely on dead-code work in controls.
algorithm: Keep the transitive dependency closure of the root over ALL alternatives; remap in topological order. No probability-based pruning and no choice removal from original support. Root without solutions stays infeasible.
methods: Apply the SAME root-dependency pass to greedy_witness, lex_integer, greedy_cached_prefix, monotone and native sat_cached_prefix, before their preparation. Enumeration is independent and unchanged.
cost: Charge original compilation AND pruning to each forest decoder, report original/relevant node and alternative counts separately. No prepared-vs-unprepared comparison.
cases: All original six development and twelve held-out documents, 4/8/16 masks, top16, threshold/cap/fallback, three rotated repeats. Same CPU and GPU protocols, no outcome-based exclusions or replacing failed cases.
success: Unchanged >=20% median total wall AND CPU reduction versus EVERY completed control, favorable sign in all repeats. Exact shared support/proposals/commitments/output; compare with original campaigns as an additional correctness check.
scientific_scope: This is a strengthening of competent comparators, not a new theoretical result. Original campaigns remain archived. Publication and native EPIC superiority remain unconfirmed. If prior gains disappear, reject them as a reason to choose this implementation.
